# ScaleSmiths

> ScaleSmiths is a founder-led business growth and engineering company based in Hucknall, Nottinghamshire. We identify what is holding a business back, build the right digital solution, and can remain involved through a scoped Digital Growth Partnership.

## What ScaleSmiths is

- **Business Growth & Engineering** — diagnose the constraint before prescribing technology.
- **Web Design & Development** — conversion-focused websites and production-grade engineering.
- **E-Commerce Development** — storefronts engineered to sell.
- **AI Implementation Consultancy** — practical AI built into real business workflows.
- **Business Automation Consultancy** — removing manual work so teams scale without headcount.
- **Digital Growth Partnership** — prioritised ongoing improvement across the digital estate.

## Location & coverage

- Based in Hucknall, Nottinghamshire (NG15), United Kingdom.
- Serves Nottingham, Hucknall, Nottinghamshire, the East Midlands and clients across the UK.

## Positioning

ScaleSmiths is strategy-led. Work spans conversion-focused websites, local SEO and content architecture, e-commerce, custom web applications, AI implementation, business automation, managed infrastructure, and an ongoing Digital Growth Partnership. Pricing is scoped to the agreed outcome and delivery risk.
